title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Payroll-Continuity Protection
content:
Payroll-continuity protection — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan missed-recovery review.

The payroll-continuity protection rests on the plan's paydays whose period close line carries a pay date in the last three months:

- **five or more** let the plan keep the tier one below its current tier;
- **three or four** the tier two below;
- **fewer than three** leave only Paystride Access Starter.

A tier named as one or two below the current tier never goes below Paystride Access Starter. A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

| Period closes with a pay date in the last three months | Highest tier the plan may keep |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | one below its current tier |
| 3 or 4 | two below its current tier |
| 0 to 2 | Paystride Access Starter only |

*Hypothetical:* a weekly-paid worker whose plan closed twelve pay periods in the last three months may keep the tier one below; a worker whose plan closed four semimonthly periods in that window, two below; a plan with two period closes in the window, only Paystride Access Starter.
